fusions.name: Sent After It
fusions.desc: Rushes you to a target up to 6 tiles away to bite and hold on, which deals 13 damage, leaves it [Pinned] for 2 seconds and 10% easier to wound for 5 seconds. Its damage rises 8% for each ally within 5.5 tiles of you (max 32%).

fusions.name: Circle the Wards
fusions.desc: Slams the ground around you, which deals 26 damage to every enemy within 3.5 tiles. When it hits, you and your allies deal 20% more damage for 12 seconds.

fusions.name: Stand Over Them
fusions.desc: The damage you take is reduced by 25% for 10 seconds. A hound fights beside you for 8 seconds, striking for 3 every 1.4 seconds.

fusions.name: Barded Mastiff
fusions.desc: A bonded mastiff in shell barding fights beside you, biting for 4 damage every 1.5 seconds. Anything it bites moves 20% slower for 2 seconds.
